Name: Mixed Seed Unmixer
Author: Poindexter1985
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]This mod adds machine output rules to the Seed Maker that take Mixed Seeds or Mixed Flower Seeds as inputs, and outputs randomized crop seeds.

This was born out of my frustrations when playing with mods that eliminate or restrict the selection of seeds for purchase from shops (like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21573]Find Your Own Seeds[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26086]Realistic Season Shop Inventory[/url]), paired with mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22311]Re-Mixed Seeds[/url]. I love the concept of being constrained on seed selection and working with that you can get from Mixed Seeds... but in practice, my fixation on having nice, neatly arranged crop fields makes using Mixed Seeds infuriating. I hate having different crops scattered randomly around, unable to even line them up by growth times.

I found myself wishing I could enjoy the randomized selection of crops as a fun gameplay constraint, but have the randomization happen [b]before[/b] I put the seeds in the soil. So I made it so. Because this precludes the use of Re-Mixed Seeds or similar mods, I added configuration options to expand the selection of seeds that the Seed Maker can create from Mixed Seeds.

This is [b]intended[/b] to be paired with mods that limit the purchase of seeds and that make the Seed Maker available earlier, but this mod does neither of those things.[/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Mod Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Mixed Seeds and Mixed Flower Seeds can be consumed by the Seed Maker to produce a single, random crop seed from a list of possible seeds[/*]
[*]The default configuration behaves as close to vanilla seed restrictions as I could make it: the Seed Maker will produce only the seeds for crops that can normally result from planting Mixed Seeds, and the list of seeds is restricted based on the current season and the location (the Seed Maker will output different seeds if placed on Ginger Island)[/*]
[*]There are multiple options to expand the range of seeds the Seed Maker will produce, as well as to ignore the current season and generate seeds from all seasons[/*]
[*]There are multiple options to include seeds from supported mods in the output (added them as possible outputs to either Mixed Seeds or Mixed Flower Seeds, as appropriate).[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Supported Mods[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508][b]Cornucopia - More Crops[/b][/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290][b]More Flowers[/b][/url]: Settings to include seeds by pack (Essential, Extended, Herbs), with restrictions also based on how the seeds are normally obtained.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20340][b]Growable Forage and Crop Bushes[/b][/url]: Individual toggles per enabled crop[/*]
[*]ZoeyHoshi's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25619][b]Vanilla Forage Crops and Bushes[/b][/url] and [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25788]Ridgeside Forage Crops and Bushes[/url][/b]:[b] [/b]Individual toggles per enabled crop[/*]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url][/b]: Multiple toggles to choose which groups of seeds to include[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27049][b]Wildflour Atelier Goods[/b][/url]: Option to include seeds for all added crops, as well as an option to add a Seed Maker recipe to unmix WAG's four custom mixed seeds (Alchemist and Garden Variety seeds). I don't know WAG's added crops well enough to know if there should be more selective options to exclude some crops.[/*]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32385]Rose and the Alchemist[/url][/b]: Options to include Flower crops, Mushroom/Forage crops, and Moondrop crops.[/*]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18109]Distant Lands - Witch Swamp Overhaul[/url][/b]: Options to include Vile Ancient Fruit and Vile Mint[/*]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16197]Bear Family[/url][/b]: Option to include Stone Bramble[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13883][b]Eli and Dylan[/b][/url]: Option to include this mod's crops. This mod is new for me and I don't know if any seeds have special access requirements that justify individual settings.[/*]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22591]Adventurer's Guild Expanded[/url][/b]: Separate options to include Slime Heart and Zinnia seeds[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8630][b]Walk to the Desert Redux[/b][/url]: Option to include Eerie Plant Seeds[/*]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29995]Metalcore Goes Cottagecore[/url][/b]: Option to include Elder Lily Seeds[/*]
[/list][size=4]General compatibility notes:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][b]Other modded crops[/b]: Shouldn't cause any issues, but modded seeds will not be produced by unmixing Mixed Seeds unless support has been explicitly added. I've added support for the mods I'm personally playing with. Others may be considered on request (and I'm willing to accept Pull Requests), but they're not my priority.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url][/b]: Compatible, but with a quirk: the Seed Maker has a random chance to produce Mixed Seeds in the base game. Those Mixed Seeds can then get immediately consumed by the Seed Maker to unmix them if you aren't controlling which chests are used as inputs or outputs for Automate.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Mixed seed expansion mods (like [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22311]Re-Mixed Seeds[/url][/b] or [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30399]Oops All Mixed Seeds[/url][/b]): Shouldn't have any interactions I'm aware of. My mod won't change how they behave, and they won't change what the Seed Maker unmixes seeds into.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]Category and other changes[/b]: Mods that change crop categories (for example, turning Daffodils or Dandelions into Flower crops) or other attributes of crops or seeds won't be respected by my output rules. If my mod was written to unmix a seed from Mixed Flower Seeds, it won't care if the crop has stopped being a Flower.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]Config Validity[/b]: I have a lot of toggles to enable or disable different patches. As a pure Content Patcher mod, my mod does not (and cannot) check that your config makes sense. Don't enable inclusion of seeds in my mod if you have those seeds disabled in other mods. I don't think you can really break anything, but you may get warning messages spammed in your SMAPI console.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]It is very possible to configure this mod such that there may be only one or two valid seed outputs (for example, if you have Seasonal Restrictions enabled and only a single winter seed enabled), in which case your Seed Maker will just spit out those seeds. That's on you.
[/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]There are a lot of config options. I have not exhaustively tested every permutation, and I have not tested that every modded crop is accurately accounted for. Please report any errors you find.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b]
[/size][/color]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download and unzip Mixed Seed Unmixer into \Stardew Valley\Mods\[/color][/*]
[/list]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]AI Disclaimer
[/b][/size][/color][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]I'm not tagging this as AI-Generated Content, but I also can't claim it's certified, grass-fed, 100% LLM-free. There are 371 EditData patches in this mod currently, and most of them are repetitions of the exact same thing with different crop ID references. I did use Claude to cut down on the tedium of copying and pasting patches.[/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]See Also[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3][url=https://github.com/poindexter1985/vault85-mixed-seed-unmixer]Source code on Github[/url][/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]If I abandon this mod or disappear, or if you think you can do it better, don't hesitate to fork or continue it. Use the open license, that's what it's there for.[/size][/color]
